notes: Values are copied as printed at the source. 'derived' blocks are this file's own arithmetic, with the formula shown; they are estimates, not source values.

Unknown = null (shown as '—' in the markdown).

summary: ArduPilot (S13): hover ideally ~50% throttle; >70% dangerous. Battery state not specified.
ArduPilot (S14): learned Q_M_THST_HOVER ~0.3-0.6; thrust is voltage-scaled between Q_M_BAT_VOLT_MAX (4.2 V/cell) and Q_M_BAT_VOLT_MIN (3.3 V/cell), sag-compensated by default.
T-Motor vendor guide (S16): T/W minimum 1.6, recommended 2.0, professional 2.2-2.5; battery state not specified.
ArduPilot forum users (S17): 1.2-1.5 (2022) and 2-2.2 (2024); not official.
Commercial quadplanes (S18, S19): MTOW published, lift-motor max thrust not published; T/W not computable.
PX4 docs: no T/W or hover-throttle recommendation found (searched docs.px4.io 2026-11-01).
Peer-reviewed quadplane T/W sizing value: not retrieved (Wiley review DOI 10.1155/2022/1803638 returned HTTP 403).

derived.basis: MTOW 6.95 kg (caller's 6.9-7.0 kg midpoint); R13 T/W >= 1.6 -> required per motor = 1.6 x 6950 g / 4 = 2780 gf. Estimates, not source values.

current_at_2780gf_per_motor.formula: linear interpolation between bracketing maker rows; pack current = 4 x motor current (ESC and wiring losses ignored)

molicel_6S2P_P50B_estimate.formula: R_pack = 6 x 12.8 mOhm / 2; capacity = 2 x 5.0 Ah; energy = 6 x 3.6 V x 10 Ah; cell mass = 12 x 71 g (max); continuous = 2 x 60 A (80 C cut-off)

boom_disconnect_check.basis: Caller's figures: each boom disconnect carries 2 lift ESCs, ~28 A hover, up to ~64 A full thrust. Estimate, not a source value.
boom_disconnect_check.XT60H_12AWG: hover 28 A < 30 A rated (93 % of rating); 64 A > 60 A 1-min MC (107 %)
boom_disconnect_check.XT90H_10AWG: hover 28 A = 62 % of 45 A; 64 A = 71 % of 90 A 1-min MC (above 45 A continuous)
boom_disconnect_check.AS150U_8AWG: hover 28 A = 40 % of 70 A; 64 A = 91 % of 70 A continuous
